title: Shoot, Push and Relocate
description: After each shot the player pushes to a new spot and must catch the next pass on the move, training relocation and a ready chair rather than a stationary catch.

content.objective: Relocate with two or three strong pushes after a shot and arrive squared and ready to catch and shoot again.
content.setup: Three spots around the arc (left wing, top, right wing). A passer with two balls under the basket.
content.organization: Shooter and passer swap after 60 seconds; a rebounder can join groups of three.
instructions: The shooter starts at the left wing, receives a pass and shoots.
Immediately after the release, push to the top spot with two or three strong strokes.
Brake and square the chair to the basket as you arrive, hands up for the ball.
Catch and shoot; then push to the right wing and repeat.
Count makes in 60 seconds, then swap roles.
coachingPoints: First push starts as soon as the ball leaves the hands.
Turn the chair with the final stroke so it arrives facing the rim.
Show a target with both hands before the pass comes.
commonMistakes: Watching the shot instead of relocating.
Arriving still rolling and shooting off balance.
Pushing to the spot and turning afterwards, which costs time.
content.safety: Passer stays under the rim, out of the shooter's push lane; check that anti-tip casters are fitted for fast braking.
progressions: Add a defender who closes out on the catch.
Relocate to a random spot called by the passer.
regressions: Allow a full stop before the catch.
Two spots only, closer to the rim.
variations: Relocate along the baseline (corner to short corner).
Shoot off one push toward the passer (shooting off the push).
successCriteria: Arrives squared at each spot before the pass is released.
Makes at least 5 shots in 60 seconds.
content.gameApplication: Shooters who relocate after passing or shooting get open again; a stationary shooter is easy to guard.
